comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Its fiber broadband business sells internet to residential and business subscribers, so a Shentel broadband customer could buy the same service.

comps.label: C1
comps.reason: It sells local telephone and broadband internet to rural residential and business subscribers, so a Shentel customer could buy the same service.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Its satellite broadband sells internet to residential and enterprise customers and telecom carriers, so a Shentel customer could buy it instead.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: It sells billing and customer software to cable and telecom operators, the same kind of provider that Shentel is.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: It sells cable networks to pay-TV distributors, which are the same kind of video providers that Shentel is.

note: C3 was not in this list because it was not in the adjacent set. Of the ones shown, the broadband sellers fit best. Utilities don't qualify, and C8 and C2 qualify only through shared buyers.
